semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides surface finishing solutions relevant to the electronics and PCB sectors, which are integral to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Grauer and Weil (India) Limited, also known as Growel, offers specialized surface finishing solutions, including advanced plating chemistries and equipment technologies, primarily for the electronics and PCB sectors within the semiconductor industry. Their solutions emphasize corrosion protection and environmental sustainability, catering to high-quality standards.
